"Whose Heart Are You Breaking Tonight?" is a song written by Ted Murry and Benny Davis and performed by Connie Francis.
Overview
In 1964, the track reached No. 7 on the U.S. adult contemporary chart and No. 43 on the Billboard Hot 100, and slightly worse positions on other American charts. It also charted well in Australia.
It was featured on her 1965 album, Connie Francis Sings "For Mama".
The song was translated into Italian as "Un altro amore" and was the B-side to her Italian single "Ho bisogno di vederti".
